THE_QUESTION: Does reducing the fixed defender allocation from two agents to one prevent the 4v4 Pole-B collapse while preserving Pole-A specialization?
RESEARCH_CLAIM_TEMPLATE: Each opponent-conditioned specialist is decomposed into two explicit role policies, ATTACK and DEFEND, initialized from the same specialist and trained under an identical role-allocation and optimization procedure. The same construction is applied at every team size and to both strategic regimes.
PAPER_STORY: PAPER_END_TO_END_STORY_V1.json — this spec is Stage 2 (role-organized teachers) of that freeze. Do not add a router or a sharing arm inside this file.

ARCHITECTURE_locked.foundation: repaired 1M entity-repair specialist pi_s (frozen file on disk; never overwritten)

branches.ATTACK: trainable network pi^ATTACK_s, warm-started as a clone of pi_s
branches.DEFEND: trainable network pi^DEFEND_s, warm-started as a clone of the SAME pi_s

ARCHITECTURE_locked.deployment: CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k) assigns roles once per episode (fixed_for_episode); ATTACK slots execute pi^ATTACK_s; DEFEND slots execute pi^DEFEND_s
ARCHITECTURE_locked.k_note: Resolved k MUST be passed explicitly (--role-k-defend). Do not use rl.custom_ppo.rule_role_assignment.role_k (that helper is N/2 and would wrongly give k=3 at 6v6).

JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.budget_semantics_locked: 200000 environment-training steps for the composite team (shared rollout). Samples are routed to ATTACK or DEFEND by role. This is NOT 200k updates per branch independently, and NOT two sequential 200k experiments.
JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.structure: ONE composite PPO run per (N, s). Both branches are present for the whole run. This is not two unrelated sequential experiments.
JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.initialization: Both pi^ATTACK_s and pi^DEFEND_s load weights from FOUNDATION_CHECKPOINTS[N][s] (identical file, identical sha256). Fresh optimizer / progress counters for the 200k stage.
JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.role_assignment_during_training: CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=ceil(N/3)), fixed_for_episode=true, on every episode of the training pole for strategy s

sample_routing.ATTACK_experiences: decision-eligible, alive agent-ticks whose assigned role is ATTACK update ONLY pi^ATTACK_s under the ATTACK objective
sample_routing.DEFEND_experiences: decision-eligible, alive agent-ticks whose assigned role is DEFEND update ONLY pi^DEFEND_s under the DEFEND objective
sample_routing.no_cross_branch_gradients: an ATTACK tick must not write gradients into pi^DEFEND_s; a DEFEND tick must not write gradients into pi^ATTACK_s

ATTACK_objective.locked_choice: standard on-policy PPO policy+value(+entropy) losses on ATTACK-assigned decision points only, using the same PPO hyperparameters as the specialist trainer's production defaults for this codebase's split/role stage
explicitly_not: leaving ATTACK frozen for the 200k stage
a second unrelated 200k run after DEFEND finishes
undefined 'train an attacker' prose without the decision-point filter above

DEFEND_objective.ppo: standard on-policy PPO on DEFEND-assigned decision points only (same PPO hyperparameter inheritance as ATTACK)

n_prime_teacher_auxiliary.loss: CE(macro,GO_TO)+CE(waypoint,w_N') on DEFEND-role, alive, decision-eligible agent-ticks

JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.decision_point_filtering: only decision-eligible agent-ticks enter either branch's PPO minibatches (same semi-Markov decision semantics as the rest of the suite)
JOINT_200K_TRAINING_locked.checkpoint_rule: periodic checkpoints every 100000 steps; terminal weights at ~200k are the sole selected artifact (no early stopping, no checkpoint shopping)

SUCCESS_CRITERIA_locked.decided_by: PI, 2026-10-01/02: do not require Delta_A, Delta_B >> 0 as the sole success definition
SUCCESS_CRITERIA_locked.not_required: large positive deltas on both poles as a necessary condition for a successful experiment
SUCCESS_CRITERIA_locked.primary_success: strategic differentiation under the frozen dual-branch construction
requires_all_of: A and B have reproducibly different behavioral signatures (same construction; differences not explained by seed noise alone)
those differences are interpretable relative to Pole A (OP6) vs Pole B (OP7)
crossover or another functional measure shows that the distinction matters (the strategies are not mere stylistic variants)

delta_interpretation.role: supporting functional evidence, not the sole success criterion
delta_interpretation.modest_positive_example: Delta_B = +0.10 can support the claim if B shows a clearly different, repeatable strategy with a measurable Pole-B advantage
delta_interpretation.large_positive_without_behavior: Delta_B = +0.80 with no behavioral explanation is a strong specialization result but a weaker strategy story
delta_interpretation.negative_or_null_at_a_scale: reportable under this freeze (e.g. scaling difficulty at 6v6); do not redesign k or losses after seeing results

forbidden_post_hoc: redefining success as Delta >> 0 only after seeing confirmatory numbers
changing architecture at a weak scale to chase larger deltas
